en: This is a sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly and densely forested rural landscape. The town is composed of many closely-built houses, some larger multi-story buildings, and several visible church spires, suggesting older European architecture. The foreground has open pasture or field, and the wooded hills dominate the background. The caption in the upper left reads 'Olbernhau i. Erzgeb.', which appears to be an abbreviation.
